query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_entries,
  SUM(CASE WHEN champion1_name IS NOT NULL AND champion1_name != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as identified,
  SUM(CASE WHEN champion1_name IS NULL OR champion1_name = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unidentified
FROM leaderboard_entries
LIMIT 1;
